title: DIENTON _ furniture family
description: Dienton is a family of furniture made of plywood and bright white MDF. It is easy to manufacture, all cuts are at 90º, it can be easily manufactured with a CNC router and assembled with screws. Dienton is designed for different stages of childhood. The modules have some parts in common, to optimize the use of material in production.
It is possible to create different combinations or use each piece of furniture individually
The desk in its initial form has the standard measurements of a children’s desk. Work area: Height: 52cm Width: 70cm depth 42cm
It can be bought/sold individually or together, using the necessary pieces of furniture according to the space of the room.
It can be anchored to the wall for the safety of smaller children.
Higher desk configuration, for use by children over 10 years old, Dienton is a family of furniture that lasts over time.
